hooks.text: 最多六名窃贼朋友合作闯入怪镇，先完成强制目标，再由队伍决定是否冒险追求额外任务
hooks.excerpt: Dive into this friendslop horror comedy game for up to six burglar buddies. Pull of grand heists in the strangest town in the world, filled with odd locations, bizarre mutations of science…and the neighborhood’s… friendliest… dog? Complete mandatory goals, tackle optional objectives if the squad is feeling ambitious, then make out like the bandits that you literally are.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 掉落台灯或撞到墙角都会填高噪音槽，动静过大便召来守镇的变异宠物猎杀整队
hooks.excerpt: Acquire piles of epic loot without making noise, or risk summoning mutated pets that defend the town. Every dropped lamp and bumped corner will fill up the noise meter, and lead the squad one step closer to chew toy territory.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 成功把赃物带回基地后分账，再升级藏身处和货车、装饰地下室并更换服装，为下一次劫案扩充配置
hooks.excerpt: Make it back to home base with your ill gotten gains, split the cash, and upgrade your burglar hideout. Purchase van enhancements, cool posters, basement themes, and even new drip so you can roll into the next heist in style.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

baseline.message: 首期基线，暂无可比趋势。
